description: List task runs, filtered by status, task, tag, queue, schedule or a time window. This is the main read for 'what ran, and what failed?'. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pagination. Omit for the first page.

from.description: Epoch milliseconds lower bound on creation time.

isTest.description: Only test runs, or only real ones.

machine.description: Only runs on these machine presets.

schedule.description: Only runs created by this schedule.

status.description: Only runs in these states, e.g. ["FAILED","CRASHED"]. Others include PENDING, EXECUTING, COMPLETED, CANCELED, TIMED_OUT.

taskIdentifier.description: Only runs of these task ids.

to.description: Epoch milliseconds upper bound on creation time.

version.description: Only runs of this deployment version.

name: trigger_list_runs
title: List runs
